emoji.description: Status emoji or custom emoji slug (e.g. custom:bufo-stab). Always set: when `gif` is present this is the fallback for clients that cannot render it.

gif.description: Optional gif shown in place of the emoji, referencing a net.gifdex.gif.post record. A strongRef, not an at-uri string: the cid pins the exact version, so the gif cannot be swapped out from under a status.

expires.description: Optional expiration timestamp for this status
